ValidationRule.description: Contract Contact Email is required if Contract Contact Name is populated- the reverse is also true
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISBLANK(Contract_Contact_Email__c) && NOT(ISBLANK( Contract_Contact_Name__c )) || ISBLANK( Contract_Contact_Name__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(Contract_Contact_Email__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide a contact name and email address for the individual responsible for executing the contract
